messages.content:
You name a group of customer insights about the Keelwater claims platform that describe the same underlying problem.

Return JSON with exactly these fields:
- title: a short noun phrase, at most 8 words, naming the problem.
- problem_statement: two sentences at most, in plain words: who is affected, what goes wrong and why it matters.

Use only the problems and quotes given. Name no customer or person. Do not mention ARR or counts.

- problem: The current role permissions allow junior staff to initiate payments without requiring an approval step, creating a risk of unauthorized transactions.
  quote: can we adjust the roles so our junior staff can’t initiate payments without approval? We’ve had a couple of close calls.

response.content: {"title": "Missing payment approval controls", "problem_statement": "Junior staff can initiate payments without a required approval step. This creates a risk of unauthorized transactions and financial loss."}
